item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Santo Tomas, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Cuenca, San Jose, Ibaan, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Tanauan, Talisay, Laurel, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Taal, Lian, Balayan, Calaca, Lemery, and Calatagan), Bulacan (Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Rafael, Santa Maria, and Meycauayan), Cavite (Silang, Tagaytay, Amadeo, Indang, Mendez, Alfonso, Maragondon, and Ternate), Laguna (San Pablo, Alaminos, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, Calamba, and Cabuyao), Metro Manila (Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas, Taguig, Pateros, Makati, and Pasay), Nueva Ecija (Carranglan), Pampanga (Candaba, Apalit, San Simon, and San Luis), Quezon (Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, Unisan, Plaridel, Gumaca, Alabat, Perez, San Antonio, Tiaong, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig, and Pagbilao), Rizal (Rodriguez, San Mateo, Cainta, Antipolo, and Taytay), and Zambales (Palauig, Masinloc, Candelaria, Iba, Olongapo, Subic, Santa Cruz, Castillejos, and San Antonio) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
